rule.name: UAM_requestaccess_generateEmailBodyForManager
rule.description: To generate the email body for manager
rule.definition:
a!localVariables( local!recordlink: #"_a-0000ef67-4afa-8000-9e56-011c48011c48_1205782"(), local!userName: ri!userName, local!pmName: ri!pmName, /* Get team details */ local!teamdetails: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(ri!teamid), #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1132811"(TeamId: ri!teamid), {} ), local!teamNames: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!teamdetails), joinarray( index( local!teamdetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:bb51e73c-01e7-4e73-8a7b-4187491dde54/d4a08ef8-b6c6-4db9-bb25-3be3a8bcbf2a", {} ), ", " ), "–" ), /* Get organization details */ local!orgDetails: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(ri!orgid), #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1123673"(orgId: ri!orgid), {} ), local!orgName: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!orgDetails), index( local!orgDetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:008dc9c2-5821-421b-b1dd-e322b8e6665f/0f073a93-5255-4fd3-bdba-87d2febf50e9", "–" ), "–" ), /* Get team roles */ local!teamroles: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(ri!teamid), #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1138645"(teamid: ri!teamid, isActive: true()), {} ), local!teamgroupids: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!teamroles), index( local!teamroles, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:139cb21e-dd78-4694-a8ad-b43e2d51226f/da39fffc-c223-49f0-b99c-5a3a8f8ad3b8", {} ), {} ), /* Get group details */ local!groupdetails: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!teamgroupids), #"_a-0000eef8-4604-8000-9e54-011c48011c48_1136584"(groupid: local!teamgroupids), {} ), local!groupnames: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!groupdetails), index( local!groupdetails, #"urn:appian:record-field:v1:c4386edd-8146-4849-a78b-d8ad760265af/e8ca0cac-e7b4-4dfc-a87f-9c9f6e12a24c", {} ), {} ), /* Format group names as HTML list */ local!groupNamesHtmlList: if( a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!groupnames), "
    " & joinarray( #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!groupnames, expression: "
  • " & fv!item & "
    • " ), "" ) & "
", "No roles requested" ), " Team Access Request - Action Required

Dear " & local!pmName & ",

A new Team Access Request has been submitted and requires your attention.

Request Details
Requested By: " & local!userName & "
Organization: " & local!orgName & "
Team Name: " & local!teamNames & "
Requested Roles: " & local!groupNamesHtmlList & "

Review Request

Please review and take appropriate action on this request.


This is a system generated mail. Please do not reply.

" )
